acceptance_criteria: `pub enum BooleanOp { Union, Cut, Intersect }` (public; the existing crate-private `ffi::BooleanOp` may be replaced by or mapped from it), `pub enum Operand { A, B }` and `pub struct OpHistory { pub modified: Vec<(Operand, SubShape, Vec<SubShape>)>, pub generated: Vec<(Operand, SubShape, Vec<SubShape>)> }`, documented.

`Kernel::boolean_tracked(&self, op, a, b) -> Result<(Self::Shape, OpHistory), KernelError>`: the same solid as `union` / `cut` / `intersect`, plus its history. `modified` has exactly one entry per face of `a` and per face of `b`, with its images in the result: itself if unchanged, several if split, none if deleted. Images are sorted by index. Documented and implemented for `OcctKernel`.

Tests (behind `occt`); volumes within a relative 1e-6, boxes within 1e-6. Input faces are found with `sub_shape_bounding_box`: split top face (cut), absorbed boss (union), embedded boss (union), intersect; in all four tests, every result face is the image of exactly one input face in `modified`, and the tracked and untracked calls give the same volume and face count.
Errors, each with a test and never a panic: an empty result is reported as the untracked boolean reports it (e.g. a cut that removes all of `a`).
No new dependencies. `swx-kernel` still has no workspace dependencies. Every new shim function is `noexcept` and catches C++ exceptions; every new `unsafe` block is in `ffi` and documented.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass, and so do the CI `swx-kernel (occt)` job commands.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
